instructions.label: ONLY THE PERSON WHOSE NAME APPEARS ON THIS LABEL SHOULD TAKE THE TEST.

addressChange.prompt: Please print name/address corrections on label.
addressChange.applyTo: Does the change apply to all family members ______ or just to you ______?

instructions.addressChangeDetails: If Address Changed: What is your new phone number? (Please include area code.) _______________________

message.content: With this ballot I am enclosing six packs of cigarettes coded as follows: 3 packs and 3 packs. Please read the directions for each part carefully and pay special attention when judging these cigarettes—we will be sending you a free carton of the test cigarette you choose in Part III.
message.closing: When the ballot is completely filled out, please return it to me in the enclosed postage-paid envelope. Thank you very much—your cooperation in this test is most helpful.

testInstructions.firstStep: FIRST SMOKE ONE OR TWO PACKS OF THE CIGARETTES CODED ______.
testInstructions.phrases: Read the phrases at each end of each line of boxes. Which phrase do you think describes the cigarette coded ______.

scale.left: If the one on the left describes it better, mark an X in one of the boxes on the left side—the more you think the description is true, the closer to the left side.
scale.right: If you think the phrase on the right side of the boxes is a better description, mark one of the boxes on the right side—again the truer it is, the closer to the right side.

mildTaste.negative: Does not have a mild taste

goodTaste.negative: Does not have a good taste

draw.negative: Does not have an easy draw

dryTaste.negative: Does not have a dry taste in the mouth
dryTaste.positive: Has a dry taste in the mouth

aftertaste.negative: Does not leave a good aftertaste in my mouth
aftertaste.positive: Leaves a good aftertaste in my mouth
